verdict: A strong CPL week cut short by a live spend blackout.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 95 leads at $5.23 per lead, and the most recent 7-day window showed an 85.71% surge in lead volume that drove cost per lead down 27.94% — a genuine performance win. That momentum stalled on September 25–26, when Meta ad delivery went dark and spend dropped to zero, putting the cost-per-lead gain at direct risk of reversing. In parallel, Google Business Profile actions fell 62.5% week-over-week and website sessions dropped 48%, signalling that organic visibility is softening. Restoring Meta delivery is the immediate priority this week, and the outstanding setup milestones — including search campaigns, local SEO triage, and tracking — are being actioned to build a more stable foundation going into October.

cost per lead this period, down 27.94% in the most recent 7 days
planned program milestones now being completed to stabilise and expand delivery
